body: Independent review found no defects in the eight allowed source/test paths. The hook uses a fixed browser script without interpolating event input, suppresses failures, and matches the task specification. Manifest wiring, generated settings, optional-key behavior, runtime parity registration and documentation are consistent. Validation logs show 76 generator tests and 52 runtime tests passing, including both required new tests; render-check reports no drift. The reviewer independently ran shellcheck and git diff --check successfully. Live Claude subagent delivery and browser reload latency remain for the orchestrator's post-install verification.
